subject: Post-demo: shared responsibility, SOC 2 evidence, and partner inventory
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@medisync.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: shared responsibility, SOC 2 evidence, and partner inventory

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the procurement side:

- You asked for a short subprocessor inventory (cloud partners + managed services) and a mapping of where PHI/PII might traverse our systems.
- You also requested a SOC 2 summary and a pointer to the minimal evidence we can share with an NDAs in place.
- Action: We will send a CSV export of our current subprocessor roster, a one-page SOC 2 summary, and a short shared-responsibility matrix that maps what stays in your control vs. what Redwood manages.

Deliverables and owners:
- Subprocessor roster (csv) — Monica will attach a scoped export (cloud, storage, telemetry).
- SOC 2 one-pager + evidence pointers (pdf) — I will attach the summary and note which items require a formal DPA/inspection.
- Shared responsibility matrix (xlsx) — Karthik will add the runtime/edge notes for cloud-hosted deployments.

Proposed timeline: attachments by end of day tomorrow (Wed 4/28). Can you confirm who on your security team should receive the full CSV (cc or separate link)?

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(e) evelyn.hart@redwood.com | (m) +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Green <alex.green@medisync.com>

Cc: security@medisync.com, ops@medisync.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: shared responsibility, SOC 2 evidence, and partner inventory

Evelyn —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Yes, please send everything you mentioned. To clarify:

1) Our security team prefers attachments via a secure share (Drive link with view-only + download disabled) rather than direct CSV in email. Can you provide a link or a short-term shared folder?
2) For subprocessor roster — we need to know for each vendor: name, hosted/managed role, data categories processed (e.g., PHI, PII, telemetry), region of processing, and whether Redwood or the partner encrypts at rest.
3) SOC 2: we only need the Type II attestation statement and the controls mapping summary. We can follow up with your legal team for any DPA redlines.

Cc'ing our security alias — please send the secure link to security@medisync.com. If you prefer a stabilized snippet in-line for scope, we can start there.

Thanks,
Alex Green
Director, IT & Security
MediSync Health
alex.green@medisync.com | +1 (212) 555-4456

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@medisync.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: shared responsibility, SOC 2 evidence, and partner inventory

Alex / Evelyn / team —

Attaching the scoped exports and a short narrative. Per Alex's preference, I'll upload the files to a secure share and post the link to your security inbox (security@medisync.com) instead of leaving the CSV in-line.

What I'm attaching (short descriptions inside):
- redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv (attachment stub) — columns: vendor_name, role, data_categories, processing_region, encryption_at_rest_by, contractual_status, last_review_date. This is a filtered export limited to subprocessors that touch customer data or telemetry (excludes infra-only vendors).
- SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (attachment stub) — one-page summary of our latest Type II period, plus guidance on which artifacts we can share after an NDA.
- shared-responsibility-matrix.xlsx (attachment stub) — mapping for Hosted API + Dedicated + Private deployments. Each tab indicates what lives in-customer-network vs. Redwood-managed services.

Key notes for MediSync:
- For Hosted API (standard): PHI may traverse Redwood-managed processing if you submit PHI into prompts. We recommend Dedicated or Private for regulated PHI workloads.
- Encryption: all customer data at rest is encrypted; field-level encryption is available for Private deployments. The csv flags which partners hold keys vs. Redwood-managed KMS.
- Data residency: most processing occurs in primary cloud regions unless you opt for a Private VPC. The csv includes region tags (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1).

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll post the secure Drive link to security@medisync.com within the hour.
2) Evelyn / Karthik will coordinate a 30-minute follow-up with your security lead to walk the matrix (proposed times: Thu 4/29 10:00-11:00 PT or Fri 4/30 09:00-10:00 PT). Please confirm.
3) If you require a signed DPA before reviewing certain evidence, loop in your legal and we will escalate to Marissa for redline support.

Let me know if you need pivoted scope (e.g., HIPAA-only view).

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment stubs: [redwood_subprocessors_v2.csv] [SOC2-summary-2026.pdf] [shared-responsibility-matrix.xlsx]
